title: Use Seedance 2.5’s multilingual video generation by prompting directly in 10+…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5’s multilingual video generation by prompting directly in 10+ native languages (instead of translating) to create localized campaigns.

Generate longer clips by using Seedance 2.5’s native 30-second generation mode.

Use Seedance 2.5’s precise video editing tools to make targeted edits rather than regenerating the whole video.

Improve control and consistency by supplying up to 50 multimodal references (e.g., images/video/text) in Seedance 2.5.
